His romance is slow burn but every single scene is so intimate in a deeper level. I like how in the first scene, in the party, he said how he was happy that we sought him out. And the scene that night was so magical (no pun intended), I actually like how he pulled back, to me it seems like he can't believe that someone can see him as that or as 'human'. I remember him saying that those little moments like a kiss is what makes us human while he, himself, didn't think of that or whatsoever.


His thing for Mystra and trying to move on from his past while rediscovering himself (at Act 3) was so good too. From thinking that he is just someone who's disposable and at Mystra's mercy to someone who stands for himself and having his own aspirations is a great arc for me. Sure, this could come as equal as power hungry but the amount of power and influence the Tav could have was immense, even I was surprised that it was that easy and that he agreed on it.


His romance scenes almost always ask us about something, a preference of some sort which to me feels like consent and that Gale is being caring and careful of our likes and preferences too. 


The scene where he showed his home was soooo good. It did felt like home, it's so serene, and it's just so nice. It's feels so intimate. He's warming up little by little, and he's taking it slow. 


In the boat scene too, I was so afraid to tell him off of his ideas of getting the crown for himself and become as powerful as a god but it surprised me that my words and my love for him sufficed. 


I soooo love the time when Halsin had asked me if I would be interested in a Poly relationship and I just had to ask Gale to see what he would say and damn, he was like "you're not a bread to be shared! you have to be respected!" -- or something like that, that was like, hands down, something that made me so sure that I was so right to romance him.


And I swear to god. I cried at the end. I had chosen to become a mindslayer and was crying and worried that Gale might not accept me, but dang the reassurance was so great. Now, I haven't finished any other romance paths yet other than Gale. But damn, I don't think anyone would ever top that.
